demo_notice: Illustrative example of a milestone certification. Not evidence, not a backtest, and not a measurement of any market. The runnable dataset is generated by `autofund demo`.
title: Cross-market relationship, from hypothesis to refusal
reason_codes: Synthetic demonstration: the relationship predicts direction but the measured movement is smaller than round-trip friction, so it is not economically usable
development and holdout are synthetic windows, not measurements of real markets

_reading_notes.why_the_windows_matter: A result is only interpretable alongside the window it was measured over and whether that window was used to build the hypothesis. Development evidence cannot certify anything.
_reading_notes.why_a_negative_result_is_published: The ability to reject a hypothesis before it risks capital is the platform's most defensible property, so the record keeps the negative findings.
_reading_notes.why_forward_window_is_null: Forward evidence cannot exist at the time a protocol is frozen. It requires data captured afterwards, so null here is honest rather than missing.
